ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.title: Shifty Shop
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITIAL.desc: Rugs, shelves, and a crooked sign promising 'THE LOWEST PRICES IN THE SPIRE'—a shop blocks the path. The merchant has his back to you. One hand holds a [gold]Relic[/gold]; another [sine][purple]kneads an identical shape[/purple][/sine] from nothing. A few finished pieces lie near the edge of the rug. Close enough to reach. He has not noticed you. Yet.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKERELICS.d: You crouch and scoop up a few pieces that look convincing enough. The weight is wrong. The edges feel soft. Behind you, someone gasps. [red][jitter]“Hey! Those are completely genuine—”[/jitter][/red] You quicken your pace before hearing the rest.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKEGOLDS.de: You hook the coin purse with your foot and give it a gentle tug. [gold]Clink.[/gold] The merchant whirls around. [red][jitter]“Hey! That's my real gold!”[/jitter][/red] At least that part was genuine.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.BEGINFIGHT.d: You seize the hand shaping the copy. The counterfeit crumples between its fingers. The merchant's grin follows. [red][jitter]“You've seen too much, pal.”[/jitter][/red]
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKETRUERELI: The last counterfeit hits the floor and splits into worthless fragments. The [gold]genuine Relics[/gold] used as references remain untouched on the table. The merchant is gone. They are not.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.title: Stumble
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.descripti: The uneven stone path winds into the dark. Your boot catches on a raised stone. [jitter]THUD![/jitter] No ground rises to meet you. When you open your eyes, rows of humming lights stretch overhead. Yellowed walls repeat in every direction, each corner leading to another just like it. There are no windows. There is no end in sight.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.S: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.descr: Corridor folds into corridor. The lights [gold][jitter]HUM[/jitter][/gold] overhead, yet your shadow always falls the same way. You scratch a mark into the wall. Around the next corner, the mark is already waiting. [red][sine]This place is learning you.[/sine][/red]
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.optio: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.EXIT.description: At last, the wallpaper splits ahead, revealing a pale opening. Cold seeps from its left edge, and the cards at your side grow strangely light. From the right comes the sound of warm water. Straight ahead, you can almost smell the stone road. You have been here long enough.
You step into the gloom. Pale light seeps between your cards. Ink and paper [purple][sine]scatter into the air[/sine][/purple], then settle into unfamiliar shapes. On your next blink, your boots are back on the uneven stone road. The wall behind you is seamless.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.TAKE_ALMOND_WATER: You follow the sound of water into the opening. A cold bottle strikes your palm. You close your hand around it. The next instant drops you back onto the stone road, clutching water far too clear to be trusted. The label reads only: [gold]ALMOND[/gold].
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.REST.description: You sit against the wall, meaning to close your eyes for only a moment. The hum of the lights stretches thin and distant. When you wake, you are lying in the middle of the stone road. Your wounds have eased, but somewhere inside you feels [purple][sine]smaller[/sine][/purple]. You decide not to dwell on it.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.LEAVE.description: You shut your eyes and leap straight into the pale void. Weightlessness. You hit the stone road hard. Behind you stands only a cold, unbroken wall. Good enough.
THINGS_MEDUSA.title: Medusa
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description: Statues multiply as the path narrows. Warriors, scholars, merchants—each face is frozen a breath before begging. At the end of the gallery, a woman reclines upon the only unbroken stone chair. The hair at her shoulders coils slowly, like a nest unwilling to wake. She does not look up. [gold][sine]“We meet again.”[/sine][/gold] You are certain this is the first time. [gold][sine]“Don't be shy. Tell me—what have you brought?”[/sine][/gold]
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFE: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Choose [blue]1[/blue] card and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Steady[/purple].
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.desc: You place the [gold]Petrified Toad[/gold] before her. Its stone eyes glimmer. The woman finally looks up, and a pleased rustling passes through her hair. [gold][sine]“So this is where you wandered.”[/sine][/gold] She plucks a single strand. It coils coldly in your palm.
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descripti: You set down [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold], coin by coin. Her fingertip traces the card you chose. The ink writhes like a startled snake, then [purple][sine]fixes itself firmly to the page[/sine][/purple]. [gold][sine]“Some things are better kept.”[/sine][/gold] When you look up, both the coins and the woman are gone. The gallery now holds one more statue clutching a purse.
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description: You clear your throat and offer a polite greeting. Silence. A few snakes hiss among her hair. As if no one has ever chosen this option before, she reaches behind the chair and produces a small bottle. It is not a potion. It is a [gold]rock shaped exactly like one[/gold]. [gold][sine]“...Courtesy repaid.”[/sine][/gold]
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.title: Cutting It Close
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.descripti: You follow a narrow trail through the dark. [jitter]SNAP![/jitter] A loose flagstone sinks beneath your foot. Somewhere along the path, a rusted mechanism [red][jitter]CLATTERS[/jitter][/red] awake. A [red]sawblade[/red] bursts from the right-hand bend and rolls down the stone path, screaming straight toward you. You reach for the first thing at hand...
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.I: Choose [blue]1[/blue] Attack or Skill card to tear apart. Remove it from your [gold]Deck[/gold], then add [blue]2[/blue] copies [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.T: Choose [blue]1[/blue] card to remove from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.selecti: Choose an Attack or Skill card to tear apart.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.selectionSc: Choose a card to throw into the saw.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.ABORTED.descripti: You reach for something—anything—but the moment is already gone. The saw tears past in a storm of grit and vanishes down the path. You steady yourself and move on.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.descrip: With no room to dodge, you thrust the card into the spinning teeth. [red][jitter]RRRRRIP![/jitter][/red] Two halves flutter to the ground. As you pick them up, each one [purple][sine]unfolds[/sine][/purple] into a complete card. Neither carries all the weight of the original, yet both are unmistakably whole. The blade tears harmlessly past. [sine]Waste not.[/sine]
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.description: You hurl the card into the spinning teeth. The saw devours it in a burst of scraps. Paper wedges around the hub, and the blade skids to a halt [red]inches from your face[/red]. You step around it and continue along the trail. Behind you, the trap grinds hungrily.
